files.name: motion-prompt-014.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Motion trail" (モーショントレイル), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #014

What it is: A fading trail follows a moving object
What the sample shows: A ball moving in a figure eight leaves a fading trail of copies behind it.
Spec:
- A ball (coral, radius 25, white centre radius 11) traces a figure eight once per 4.7 s: x = 196·sin(a), y = 62·sin(2a), with a advancing at constant speed.
- 15 copies, each placed 0.105 rad (about 0.079 s) further back along the path.
- Copy radius goes 22→6 and opacity is 0.9 × (1 − i/15) + 0.05, so older copies are smaller and fainter.
- Copy colour runs coral → yellow → blue from newest to oldest.
- Draw the oldest copy first and the ball itself last.
When to use it: Use it to show speed or a path: flying objects, cursors, points of light.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/014.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
